heard: These are the people of the province Who came up out of the captivity Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon Had carried them away They returned to Jerusalem and Judah Each to his own town With Zerubbabel and Joshua Leading the way When the seventh month came The Israelites were settled in their towns The people gathered as one in Jerusalem to stand Jeshua and Zerubbabel Set to work with their kinsmen To rebuild the altar of the God of Israel
